scope: Optimized Occupancy System & GA Evaluation (original seven-phase plan)
subset: Frozen Phase 3 winner; no new GA search or tuning
training: Independently retrain selected model on the same 1462 December 22 rows with unchanged 300-tree parameters
split: Reuse exact Phase 2 train/validation/test and embargo assignments
comparison: Report input count, accuracy, macro F1, precision/recall, reduction, per-class errors and false-empty errors
decision: Retain baseline as default demonstration estimator because it has higher four-class validation macro F1. Expose GA model as explicit compact alternative; no automatic fallback.
limitations: Previously seen validation/test data; no new independent confirmation. Later test lacks class 1. Neither estimator is established as reliable for actual control.
next_phase: Phase 5 fuzzy controller is not implemented here.
